verdict.rationale: Google Cloud's first-party IAM docs say IAM controls who can do what on which resource, and that it manages fine-grained permissions. That covers fine-grained permissions and resource-level scoping, but the pack is silent on IAM conditions and on how policies are evaluated. missing for 10: documented IAM Conditions support, documented policy evaluation/inheritance logic, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, least privilege is expressible — fine-grained IAM policies with conditions, resource-level scoping, and documented policy evaluation

citations.quote: IAM memungkinkan Anda mengontrol _siapa_ yang dapat melakukan _apa_ pada _resource mana_.
IAM est un outil permettant de gérer les autorisations précises pour Google Cloud.
